name: Kehen
source:
Main character wakes up in a closed space after a traffic accident. He meets different characters there, and together they search for a way to escape.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/07/vn-of-month-march-2008-12riven-climinal.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公在交通事故后于封闭空间醒来。他在那里遇到不同角色，并与他们一起寻找逃脱方法。
